description: I1 shake, XPBD: the block rests on a 25 cm plate that shakes along x from t = 1 s (5 Hz, 10 mm, ramped over 0.5 s); plate friction 0.3, so it slides as well as sways. Milestone render settings (Stage I1, chosen from the I1-08..10 previews): springs 150 N/m, volume stiffness matched between solvers (kv 1e6 Pa = compliance 1e-6 1/Pa). 100 substeps.
